contacts.notes: Primary high-value agency. Begin with training division contact discovery.

schema_notes.purpose: Manual verified contact injection layer for strict outreach readiness
schema_notes.promotion_rule: Target is promoted to READY only if email_valid AND phone_valid AND role_valid AND meets_strict_contact_rules are true
schema_notes.email_requirements: Must be direct work email. No generic inboxes allowed.
schema_notes.phone_requirements: Must be direct line or valid main line with extension path.
schema_notes.role_requirements: Must be relevant to training, command, or procurement.
schema_notes.scaling_strategy: Start with top 5 agencies, validate, then expand incrementally.
